summary.intent: Get the Caliper repo (Rust/OXC replacement for react-docgen-typescript) to a proper first public release on the latest Callisto, then keep CI and the PR stack healthy, restore a rewound main, and plan next hardening work.
summary.outcome: Release prep PR #33 merged and the release flow ran, but the release PR merge only ran version-pr and published nothing, so the first release was not confirmed. Later work restored main's lost history via #246, re-signed PR branches, got the stack landed, and started forks for the oxc 0.155 upgrade (#253) and a Callisto 0.16.0 bump, with #254 cleaning stray allow-list files.

repo: Callisto releases any package whose current version has no tag; with no tags and everything at 0.1.0, release PR #22 would have skipped to 0.1.1, so a minor changeset was added to make the first release 0.2.0.
oxfmt rewrites double-quoted scoped package names in .changeset/*.md to single quotes, which callisto does not strip; the name must be left unquoted.
oxfmt --check on markdown flags callisto-generated CHANGELOG.md files, so release PRs fail Lint unless **/CHANGELOG.md is in ignorePatterns of .oxfmtrc.json (PR #37).
A CLI test on the --out missing parent directory failed in CI because miette word-wraps long temp paths mid-name; substring checks must unwrap the output (crates/cli/src/commands/extract.rs).
npm provenance (NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE) requires package.json repository.url to match the GitHub repo, so URLs had to move from oxc-react-docgen to caliper.
crates/tsc-client was marked publish = false because nothing consumes it yet.

The main ruleset requires signed commits (required_signatures), a merge queue and non_fast_forward; Equivalence and Scorecard gates compare PRs against main, so a rewound main makes every PR red (KeyError: 'WebkitAppearance').
The Allow-list empty check fails on main whenever per-PR files remain in scripts/equivalence-allow.d/ after merge.
Release & Publish can fail with 'release PR snapshot changed after Callisto made its decision' when merges land back to back; the next run succeeds.
Dependabot oxc bumps can break the build because pre-1.0 OXC minors change APIs (e.g. StaticPropertyName no longer has to_string).

code.finding: Header comment said 'Pinned to callisto 0.8.0' and went stale next to the real pins; updated alongside release.yml and ci.yml.
Callisto actions are SHA-pinned with a version comment; the guard step reads .artifactSlots from the intent JSON, matching callisto 0.11.0's own release workflow.

workflow: Local main can silently hold unpushed commits; compare with origin/main (rev-list --left-right) before assuming a checkout reflects the remote.
A green workflow run is not proof of publish; verify on npm, crates.io and tags, since jobs can be skipped when the release-candidate step decides it is not a release merge.
Verify tool configuration against the pinned version's own help output and reference workflow rather than only a dry run.
Forks/sub-agents commit unsigned unless told otherwise; instruct them to sign and to stop on signing failure rather than bypass it.
Merging PRs while a branch-rewrite is running causes new conflicts; wait for the rewrite report.
Recheck main before telling the user a PR is ready, since dependabot merges move it and re-introduce lockfile conflicts.
Destructive actions like retargeting PR bases or force-pushes were blocked by the permission check until the user gave explicit, specific authorization.

friction: The user was repeatedly frustrated by red CI, conflicts on #246, unsigned commits, and slow progress while the assistant waited for user decisions.
main was force-pushed back to ef9136ed, losing about 295 commits; the actor was never determined (activity log showed castrog, the user's account).
CI on main was red from an install-action error, then Lint, Equivalence, Scorecard and Entire Gates failures stemming from the rewound base.
The 2026-09-30 install-action failure was not reproduced or diagnosed.
The first merge of the release PR run did not publish: nothing appeared on npm, crates.io or tags, and the cause was still being traced when the transcript cut off.
The permission check blocked retargeting PR bases and an initial force-push re-sign.
The user's 'merged all the version bumps' meant dependabot PRs, not release PR #22, causing a misunderstanding.
Local callisto checkout was at 0.10.0 and the mise shim at 0.5.0, so docs had to be read via the GitHub API for the 0.11.0 tag.
Several git commands needed /usr/bin/git because a shell wrapper interfered.
open_items: Confirm whether the first release (0.2.0 and later versions) actually published to npm and crates.io; the earlier run skipped plan/build/execute.
Merge #254 (stray allow-list cleanup), #253 (oxc 0.155 upgrade, replacing #248) and the Callisto 0.16.0 bump PR; then #239 (release PR) after regeneration.
Decide how the ruleset treated unsigned commits from #243, #234, #236, #230 and #231 already in main, and confirm no actor can bypass protection on main.
Rebuild the gates: 1.10x wall / 1.20x memory speed gate, output diff with no allow-list, weekly accuracy record against RDT and react-docgen.

Accuracy gaps: readonly, index signatures, RefObject; memo(forwardRef(function…)) detection; Chakra NonNullable<union>; shadcn (~40%) and antd (~80%) recall via on-demand TS; PurePanel pairing mismatch; replace the {Name}Props heuristic with a shape rule.
Uncommitted .claude/settings.json and .gemini/settings.json changes remain in the main checkout (deny rule and enabledPlugins removal, Gemini hooks wiped), awaiting a decision.
Housekeeping: retire ADRs 0023/0024, delete stale remote and local scratch branches, close stale Entire trails, close issue #1 (presets), consider a dependabot setting for OXC.
TS 7.1 on-demand follow-ups, tsc --api process lifecycle (crash, restart, timeout), monokl in-process API, and first real run of the Homebrew tap notifier.
